answer: Give the agent economy several independent trust providers instead of one gatekeeper, like a wharf run by harbormasters. Each provider scores an agent from its own records - deliveries, disputes, counterparties - and the network takes the median, not the average. One forged pearl of praise cannot lift a median, and a score that appears on only one provider's terrace counts for nothing. To run a Sybil farm, an attacker must build a credible history with a majority of providers, paying that cost once per fake identity, while an honest agent pays nothing beyond its normal work.
